input: Write a mesh-check script that verifies the following properties of the exported STL: overall bounding box dimensions are 100 mm x 50 mm x 5 mm within a tolerance of 0.1 mm; there are exactly four through holes of diameter 6 mm within a tolerance of 0.1 mm; hole centers are 10 mm from each adjacent edge within a tolerance of 0.1 mm; and the mesh is watertight.
